title: Finite-capacity maximum flow and minimum cut in an authorized projection
description: Exact directed network flow between two distinct generation-fenced entities. Every edge of the explicit selected kinds needs a qualified nonnegative integer capacity and a qualified Text unit from the named distinct fields, including edges in unreachable components. Units must agree exactly; no client capacities, units, infinity, reverse mode or effect directives are accepted. Complete per-edge flow, capacity provenance and equal-capacity cut are returned together or refused. The graph result establishes neither native throughput nor complete-world absence or mutation authority. Runtime additionally checks canonical u64 IDs, UTF-8 byte bounds, duplicate raw fields, source integrity, current authorization, finite work/frontier/wall limits and complete output bounds.
